data.title: Dow Jones Futures: Nvidia, Micron, Sandisk Dive On AI Fears; Fed Rate Hike Looms
data.description: Nvidia, Micron, and Sandisk stocks experienced a significant drop in Dow Jones Futures due to concerns related to artificial intelligence. This decline comes just before an anticipated rate hike at the upcoming Federal Reserve meeting. The market reaction suggests apprehension among investors, with Nvidia, Micron, and Sandisk all being impacted by the AI warning. The situation underscores the uncertainty surrounding the market as the Fed's decision looms, causing volatility in these tech stocks.

data.title: Health Catalyst Reports Inducement Awards Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Health Catalyst, Inc. revealed that the Compensation Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors issued 2,747,385 restricted stock units (RSUs) to Simeon Kohl under the Health Catalyst, Inc. 2026 Employment Inducement Incentive Plan. This grant is linked to Mr. Kohl taking on the roles of Chief Executive Officer and President of the Company starting the same day. The allocation of RSUs is considered a key part of Mr. Kohl's employment agreement with Health Catalyst, Inc. as outlined under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

data.title: Ascendis Announces Planned $400 Million Share Repurchase Program
data.description: In Denmark's capital city of Copenhagen, on September 14, 2026, Ascendis Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ASND) disclosed that its Board of Directors has approved a Share Repurchase Program. This move allows the company to buy back $400 million worth of its ordinary shares.

data.title: Ascendis to Regain Rights to TransCon® Technology in Metabolic and Cardiovascular Diseases
data.description: Ascendis will regain ownership of all TransCon technology-based products related to metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, including the monthly medication TransCon Semaglutide. As a result, they will be launching various initiatives in these areas, such as developing treatments for obesity. This move marks a significant shift in focus for Ascendis in the realm of metabolic and cardiovascular health.
